name: @xo/benchmark
description: Evaluation layer for the real XO pipeline (source -> XOIR -> capability contracts -> workflows -> runtime execution). Represents expected semantics/capabilities/execution classes/workflows/data flow/provenance/execution outcomes, observes the actual pipeline per stage, and produces deterministic, regression-comparable reports with per-dimension metrics (numerator, denominator, missing, unexpected) — never a single blended score. Does not implement its own compiler, contracts, or runtime.
